decision.observation: Goose is at about (0.53, 0.58) at the lower edge of the stream pool, facing the camera, just above the brown muddy path. The fallen log spans the stream above it. The 'hold Ctrl to bend forwards' banner is still at the top.

decision.memory: Moving W/Down/A, or clicking, keeps the goose in the stream pool south of the log. Next, test Ctrl alone with no movement to see whether the goose's posture changes.
